99→def parse_wireguard(config_text, custom_name=None):
100→    try:
101→        conf = {"interface": {}, "peer": {}}
102→        section = None
103→
104→        for line in config_text.splitlines():
105→            line = line.split('#')[0].split(';')[0].strip()
106→            if not line: continue
107→
108→            if line.startswith('[') and line.endswith(']'):
109→                s_name = line[1:-1].lower()
110→                if s_name == 'interface' or s_name == 'peer':
111→                    section = s_name
112→                else:
113→                    section = None
114→                continue
115→
116→            if section and '=' in line:
117→                key, val = line.split('=', 1)
118→                conf[section][key.strip().lower()] = val.strip()
119→
120→        iface = conf['interface']
121→        peer = conf['peer']
122→
123→        if not iface or not peer:
124→            return None, "Invalid WireGuard config: missing Interface or Peer"
125→
126→        endpoint = peer.get('endpoint', '')
127→        if not endpoint: return None, "No Endpoint found"
128→
129→        if ']:' in endpoint:
130→            server = endpoint.split(']:')[0][1:]
131→            port = endpoint.split(']:')[1]
132→        elif ':' in endpoint:
133→            server, port = endpoint.rsplit(':', 1)
134→        else:
135→            return None, "Invalid Endpoint format"
136→
137→        name = "WireGuard"
138→        if custom_name:
139→            name = custom_name
140→        else:
141→            first_line = config_text.splitlines()[0].strip()
142→            if first_line.startswith('#') and len(first_line) > 2:
143→                name = first_line[1:].strip()
144→            else:
145→                name = f"WG_{server}"
146→
147→        address_raw = iface.get('address', '')
148→        if not address_raw: return None, "No Address found"
149→
150→        ips = [x.strip() for x in address_raw.split(',')]
151→        ip_v4 = None
152→        ip_v6 = None
153→
154→        for ip in ips:
155→            clean_ip = ip.split('/')[0]
156→            if ':' in clean_ip:
157→                if not ip_v6: ip_v6 = clean_ip
158→            else:
159→                if not ip_v4: ip_v4 = clean_ip
160→
161→        if not ip_v4 and not ip_v6:
162→            return None, "No valid IP address found"
163→
164→        y = []
165→        y.append(f'- name: "{name}"')
166→        y.append(f'  type: wireguard')
167→        y.append(f'  server: {server}')
168→        y.append(f'  port: {port}')
169→
170→        if ip_v4: y.append(f'  ip: {ip_v4}')
171→        if ip_v6: y.append(f'  ipv6: {ip_v6}')
172→
173→        pk = iface.get('privatekey')
174→        if pk: y.append(f'  private-key: {pk}')
175→
176→        pubk = peer.get('publickey')
177→        if pubk: y.append(f'  public-key: {pubk}')
178→
179→        psk = peer.get('presharedkey')
180→        if psk: y.append(f'  pre-shared-key: {psk}')
181→
182→        dns_raw = iface.get('dns')
183→        if dns_raw:
184→            dns_list = [d.strip() for d in dns_raw.split(',')]
185→            y.append(f'  dns: {json.dumps(dns_list)}')
186→
187→        mtu = iface.get('mtu')
188→        if mtu: y.append(f'  mtu: {mtu}')
189→
190→        y.append('  udp: true')
191→
192→        # AmneziaWG options
193→        std_wg_keys = ['privatekey', 'address', 'dns', 'mtu', 'listenport', 'table', 'preup', 'postup', 'predown',
194→                       'postdown']
195→        amn_opts = {}
196→
197→        for k, v in iface.items():
198→            if k not in std_wg_keys:
199→                # Проверяем, является ли значение числом
200→                if v.isdigit() or (v.startswith('-') and v[1:].isdigit()):
201→                    amn_opts[k] = int(v)
202→                else:
203→                    # Если не число, сохраняем как есть (строкой)
204→                    amn_opts[k] = v
205→
206→        if amn_opts:
207→            y.append('  amnezia-wg-option:')
208→            for k, v in amn_opts.items():
209→                if isinstance(v, str):
210→                    if not v:  # Пустая строка
211→                        y.append(f'    {k}: ""')
212→                    else:
213→                        y.append(f'    {k}: {v}')
214→                else:
215→                    y.append(f'    {k}: {v}')
216→
217→        allowed = peer.get('allowedips')
218→        if allowed:
219→            al_list = [x.strip() for x in allowed.split(',')]
220→            y.append(f'  allowed-ips: {json.dumps(al_list)}')
221→
222→        ka = peer.get('persistentkeepalive')
223→        if ka:
224→            y.append(f'  persistent-keepalive: {ka}')
225→
226→        return {"yaml": "\n".join(y), "name": name}, None
227→
228→    except Exception as e:
229→        return None, str(e)

236→    def get_indent(s):

241→    in_proxies_list = False
242→    proxies_list_indent = -1

268→

317→def replace_proxy_block(content, target_name, new_yaml_lines):
318→    lines = content.splitlines()
319→    new_content_lines = []
320→
321→    in_proxies = False
322→    found_target = False
323→    replaced = False
324→
325→    name_pattern = re.compile(r'^\s*-\s+name:\s*(["\'])?' + re.escape(target_name) + r'(\1)?\s*$')
326→
327→    i = 0
328→    while i < len(lines):
329→        line = lines[i]
330→        stripped = line.strip()
331→
332→        if stripped.startswith('proxies:'):
333→            in_proxies = True
334→            new_content_lines.append(line)
335→            i += 1
336→            continue
337→
338→        if in_proxies and line and not line.startswith(' ') and not line.startswith('\t') and not line.startswith('#'):
339→            in_proxies = False
340→
341→        if in_proxies and not replaced:
342→            if name_pattern.match(stripped):
343→                indent_len = len(line) - len(line.lstrip())
344→                if new_yaml_lines and "name:" in new_yaml_lines[0]:
345→                    new_yaml_lines[0] = re.sub(r'name:\s*".*"', f'name: "{target_name}"', new_yaml_lines[0])
346→
347→                for n_line in new_yaml_lines:
348→                    new_content_lines.append(" " * indent_len + n_line)
349→
350→                replaced = True
351→                found_target = True
352→
353→                i += 1
354→                while i < len(lines):
355→                    next_line = lines[i]
356→                    next_stripped = next_line.strip()
357→                    next_indent = len(next_line) - len(next_line.lstrip())
358→                    if not next_stripped:
359→                        i += 1
360→                        continue
361→                    if next_indent < indent_len: break
362→                    if next_indent == indent_len and next_stripped.startswith('-'): break
363→                    i += 1
364→                continue
365→
366→        new_content_lines.append(line)
367→        i += 1
368→
369→    return "\n".join(new_content_lines)

1087→function fmtLog(raw) {
1088→    if(!raw) return "Log empty";
1089→    return raw.split('\\n').map(l => {
1090→        if(!l.trim()) return "";
1091→        l = l.replace(/\\x1b\\[32m/g, '<span class="log-green">')
1092→             .replace(/\\x1b\\[33m/g, '<span class="log-yellow">')
1093→             .replace(/\\x1b\\[0m/g, '</span>');
1094→        var m = l.match(/time="(.*?)"\s+level=(\w+)\s+msg="(.*)"/);
1095→        if(m) {
1096→            var ts = new Date(m[1]).toLocaleTimeString();
1097→            var lvl = m[2].toUpperCase();
1098→            var txt = m[3];
1099→            var cls = 'log-info';
1100→            if(lvl==='WARN'||lvl==='WARNING') cls='log-warn';
1101→            if(lvl==='ERROR'||lvl==='FATAL') cls='log-err';
1102→            return `<div class="log-line"><span class="log-time">[${ts}]</span><span class="${cls}">[${lvl}]</span> ${txt}</div>`;
1103→        }
1104→        return `<div class="log-line">${l}</div>`;
1105→    }).join('');
1106→}
